title: Studying and deep focus
text: Studying, homework, reading, coding and deep work call for steady, low-energy music with no sudden changes. Lyrics distract, so soft acoustic or lofi textures work best. Aim for calm, focused listening that fades into the background.

title: Workout and gym
text: Workout, gym, running, lifting and cardio need high-energy, fast, driving music with a strong beat. Intense, pumped-up tracks keep the pace up. Electronic and pop workout tracks are common. Not acoustic.

title: Party and dancing
text: Parties, dancing, clubs and celebrations need loud, upbeat, danceable music. High energy electronic and pop with a big beat keeps the dance floor full. Happy, energetic and fun.

title: Sleep and winding down
text: Falling asleep, bedtime, meditation and winding down call for very quiet, slow, soft music with almost no beat. Ambient and drifting textures are calming and peaceful. Lowest energy, fully acoustic or atmospheric.

title: Road trip and night driving
text: Driving, road trips, highways and late-night drives suit mid to high energy music with a steady pulse. Retro synth and synthwave with a nostalgic or moody feel pair well with the open road at night.

title: Rainy day and cozy evenings
text: Rainy days, cozy evenings at home, coffee shops and slow mornings suit gentle relaxed music. Warm jazz and soft lofi, quiet and acoustic, feel comfortable and unhurried.

title: Date night and romance
text: Date night, romance, dinner and love call for warm, smooth, mid-tempo music. Romantic jazz or soft pop with a moderate energy creates an intimate atmosphere. Slightly acoustic.

title: Heartbreak and feeling down
text: Breakups, heartbreak, sadness, crying and feeling lonely suit slow, sad, melancholy music. Quiet folk and acoustic songs let you feel the emotion. Low energy and acoustic.

title: Morning and good mood
text: Waking up, sunny mornings, cheerful, happy, positive and feel-good moments suit bright, upbeat pop. Medium to high energy, catchy and sunny, with a smile in it.

title: Venting and anger
text: Angry, frustrated, rage, venting and aggressive moods suit loud, distorted, fast guitar music. Rock with heavy riffs and very high energy releases tension. Not acoustic.

title: Confidence and hype
text: Getting ready, feeling confident, bold, hype and swagger suit rhythmic hip hop with a strong confident delivery. Medium-high energy, punchy, definitely not acoustic.

title: Picnic, outdoors and sunshine
text: Picnics, hikes, gardens, spring afternoons and outdoor hangouts suit warm acoustic folk with a happy mood and moderate energy. Light, breezy and natural.

title: Pop music
text: Pop is catchy, polished and made for broad appeal. Usually upbeat with hooks, medium to high energy, produced with electronic sounds rather than acoustic ones.

title: Lofi music
text: Lofi is mellow, hazy, beat-driven music with a warm, slightly acoustic texture. Low energy and relaxing, popular for chill background listening.

title: Rock music
text: Rock is built on loud electric guitars and live drums. Typically high energy, intense and powerful, with a raw edge rather than acoustic softness.

title: Jazz music
text: Jazz is warm, improvised and smooth, built on piano, bass and brass. Low to mid energy, relaxed and sophisticated, very acoustic.

title: Ambient music
text: Ambient is spacious, slow and atmospheric, with floating textures instead of beats. Extremely low energy, calming and meditative.

title: Synthwave music
text: Synthwave is retro eighties-style electronic music with analog synths and driving rhythms. Nostalgic and moody, medium to high energy, neon and nighttime.

title: Folk music
text: Folk is storytelling with acoustic guitar and plain vocals. Gentle, honest, low to medium energy and highly acoustic.

title: Indie pop music
text: Indie pop is a looser, more personal cousin of pop, with bright guitars and synths. Medium energy, a bit wistful or happy.

title: EDM and electronic dance
text: EDM is electronic dance music, built on drops, synthesizers and a pounding beat. Maximum energy, made for clubs and festivals, entirely electronic.

title: Hip hop music
text: Hip hop centers on rhythm and rap vocals over strong beats. Medium-high energy, confident and rhythmic, mostly electronic production.

title: Calm and relaxed
text: When you want calm, relaxed, peaceful, mellow, laid-back or chill music, choose slow tempos and soft acoustic sounds with low energy.

title: Energetic and intense
text: When you want energetic, intense, hyped, loud, powerful or fast music, choose high energy tracks with strong drums and electric or electronic sound.

title: Sad and reflective
text: When you want sad, melancholy, reflective, emotional, lonely or blue music, choose slow, quiet songs with low energy and acoustic warmth.

title: Nostalgic and moody
text: When you want nostalgic, retro, moody, dreamy or throwback music, choose mid-energy songs with vintage synth textures or warm older sounds.
